description: This Java source file defines the YAxisData class, which models a mapping between Y and Z values for a specific X coordinate, including methods for setting, adding, and retrieving values, as well as serializing the data.

classes.name: YAxisData
classes.description: Represents a mapping from Y values to Z values for a fixed X coordinate, supporting value addition, retrieval, and serialization.

classes.name: ValuesHolder
classes.description: An internal helper class within YAxisData used to store aggregated values (total and count) for calculating averages at a specific Y.

methods.name: YAxisData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the YAxisData with a specific X coordinate.

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Returns the fixed X coordinate for this data instance.

methods.name: getYs
methods.description: Returns a navigable set of Y values that have associated data.

methods.name: findZ
methods.description: Finds the Z value corresponding to a given Y by searching for the nearest floor or ceiling entry.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a specific Y value to a given Z value.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a Z value to a specific Y, updating the stored value and possibly logging the new average.

methods.name: getHolder
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ValuesHolder for a specific Y value, updating minY/maxY appropriately.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the stored Z value for a specific Y.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to provide detailed state information of the object.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes the data to a Writer in a CSV-like format.
